clips.send: Send this to someone who always reaches for the "all natural" label at the store - unease at what that word actually guarantees.
clips.caption:
He sat in the marketing meetings where this was decided, so he can tell you exactly how it works.

A product is loaded with chemicals, hydrogenated oil, ingredients that cause real harm - and the question in the room isn't "how do we make this healthy," it's "how do we convince people it's healthy." The answer: pay lobbyists to help define "all natural" so loosely that almost anything qualifies - even fifteen thousand different chemicals.

The word was never describing the product. It was describing you - what you'd believe if they just picked the right word.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the other words that mean nothing on a label.
